blocks.text: After unit testing, Integration Testing is performed to evaluate the interaction between different components or modules. While unit testing focuses on isolated units, integration testing ensures that these units work together correctly when combined. This type of testing checks for interface errors, data flow between modules, and other integration-related issues. It helps identify problems that may not arise during unit testing, such as mismatches in module communication or data handling.
